turns.text: You people are thieves and liars. I will come to the studio and smash the frames if you ignore me.

I'm sorry you feel this way. I have passed your message to a colleague, who will take over this chat shortly. If you can, please share your order number and the email used on the order so they can look into it.

input.summary: Customer is angry, called the shop thieves and liars, and threatened to come to the studio and smash frames. No order number or email was given, so the customer is not verified and no order was looked up or changed. Needs a person to follow up on the threat and the customer's concern.
